The '''Ord Sabaok system''' was located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Southern Core]] regions.<ref name="Southern" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ord Sabaok]],<ref name="CSWE" /> which served as an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] [[Colonist/Legends|outpost]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that lasted between [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]], despite it being located outside the borders of Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Around that time, a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected Ord Sabaok to the [[Giju system/Legends|Giju system]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the world was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and was the place of residence of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Barthalemew Windsloe]], who gathered information from the Empire to send to the Alliance while at the world.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ord Sabaok [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square J-13.<ref name="TEA" />
